arStrings.szText: {c_important}{u}Crackling Energy's{/u}{/c} discharge rate is increased by your Attack Speed, it's damage is increased by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%x|]{/c}, and each hit has a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"*100|%|]{/c} chance to reduce a random Cooldown by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} second.
